answer: Skip sign-up fees; audit reciprocity instead. An identity earns only while unrelated, established agents keep transacting with it over many epochs, and rewards vest slowly, like opal, layer by layer. Each epoch a yarrow sortition, a random draw, picks auditors who map the graph: honest agents form a cross-braced timber frame linked to outsiders, while a sybil farm is a closed thicket, self-citing. Closed clusters are quarantined, unvested rewards burned. Attackers must spend months building thousands of externally reciprocated histories: cost rising per fake, impossible to fake from inside.
